title: 2021-22 Panini Donruss #49 Patrick Mills Brooklyn Nets Basketball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The NBA 2021-22 Panini Donruss trading card featuring #49 Patrick Mills is a sought-after collectible for basketball fans and card collectors. This base set card showcases the talented player from the Brooklyn Nets, making it a valuable addition to any sports trading card collection. With its official NBA licensing and high-quality printing, this card is a must-have for fans of the National Basketball Association looking to collect their favorite players from the 2021-22 season.
